notes.title: Subway and Animations Update
notes.notes:
Started to expand the underground subway. Currently a known crash bug on one of the escalators.

Lots of animation updates. More variety, styles and speeds of zombie animations. Ice Cream Lady now has her proper locomotion set. Pavarotty now has his singing performance animation loop. Demon goat has a new animation set plus new attacks.

Disabled a couple of areas that were not meant to be open to the public yet.

notes.title: Added carousel to menu area
notes.notes: Carousel added to menu area. Spawns randomly

notes.title: Nixie Clock Timer added and Drop Into Grave Fixed
notes.notes:
Nixie Clock Timer added. 666 seconds maximum, top it up with accurate headshots.

Drop into grave fixed on start.

notes.title: Theatre preview
notes.notes:
Behind the green door you can get a sneak preview of the Theatre level.

There are some minor known bugs in this version. Drop into grave is currently broken.

notes.title: Navmesh fix for cemetery
notes.notes: Navmesh for cemetery didn't generate in previous patch,  now fixed

notes.title: Minor updates
notes.notes:
Railings added to cemetery sub level 2 to give it more corridor type gameplay

Demons now turn the world black and white

notes.title: Vulkan Shaders Added
notes.notes: Shaders compiled with Vulkan SM5 support

notes.title: Transparency Overdraw fixes
notes.notes:
Performance update to reduce transparency overdraw.

Player Blood HUD no longer rendered when health is 100%. Previously it rendered a fully transparent mesh all the time.

Hints and Tips widget only rendered when visible. Previously it rendered blank text at all times.

notes.title: Optimised Main Menu, added full on Snap Turn
notes.notes:
Main Menu has been optimised. It should now run more than twice as fast.

Also added full on Snap Turn options to the control settings. You can choose between 30, 45 and 90 degree snap turns. I thoroughly recommend NOT using it :) But it's there for those that want it.

notes.title: Post Process volumes set to no RayTracing
notes.notes:
Post process volumes set to no raytracing. In theory this shouldn't make a difference but it seems as though the project settings are being overridden by them.

Death should now fade to black.

Less Hazmat zombies in cemetery.

notes.title: Shader pre-caching enabled
notes.notes: Shader pre-draw and pre-caching enabled

notes.title: Valve Index startup tracking position fixed
notes.notes: A small patch to fix the Valve Index startup position not resetting

notes.title: Fix for SteamVR, Oculus and OpenXR
notes.notes:
Added a few different options for launching the game. It all seems to be working as far as I can see. So you should have at least one option that will work for you.

There is still an issue with Valve Index where the headset doesn't reset it's position on starting the game. PLEASE PRESS THE SPACEBAR to ensure you are re-centered. I will add a fix for this shortly.

Also, if running the game through SteamVR you may encounter no sound. To fix this you just need to click your mouse pointer on your monitor screen. The screen will be flickering on your desktop/laptop - this is expected as screenshare is disabled for performance reasons. To re-enable it press S.

notes.title: Steam VR and OculusXR plugins re-enabled
notes.notes: Patch to attempt to fix OpenXR issue

notes.title: Control User Settings & DirectX12 disabled (again!)
notes.notes:
It appears that some people on newer hardware are struggling with performance compared to older hardware. Somehow DirectX12 has re-enabled itself in the build settings. I've disabled it again and hopefully that should fix it....if not, please let me know in the Bug Report tab on Discussions.

In the user settings menu I've added some control over player height and turning sensitivity. These aren't currently saving, so you'll have to do it again each time you load up. I should have save settings working soon....

notes.title: Key Spawn Audio Cue plus .....Demons added
notes.notes:
Demons are in. Early stages, lots of work still to do on them.

Audio effect added when key spawns. I need to limit the range on that.

notes.title: Modular Zombies added
notes.notes: Modular Zombies added for more variety. I've been bashing my head against the desk trying to get this to stop crashing all week. I've nailed the problem down to one of the modular types, which is now disabled, when that get's fixed it will be added too.

notes.title: The Patrick Patch
notes.notes:
As the long term followers will know, you can get your name in the game with your very own personalised 'fan gravestone'. These are offered to people who go out of their way to help promote the game and offer feedback and suggestions in the Community Hub and on the Facebook Page. You can find these fan gravestones throughout the cemetery and they will randomise their locations on every play. They are destructible and eventually will be used to hide access to secret areas. 

Todays lucky recipient is...... Patrick Heneghan. Thankyou for all your contributions! Much appreciated!!

notes.title: Valve Index Support Added
notes.notes:
Valve Index support has now been added!!! It turned out to be a much bigger job than I was expecting. It transpired that the main menu where you start the game was not OpenXR compatible which meant that some players were facing 90 degrees the wrong way. I have tested this patch with Valve Index and Oculus Rift CV1 and it works as expected. I haven't had chance yet to test on Quest 2 but will be checking that this evening.

If you start the game and you are not facing the Beasts Shall Rise tombstone please let me know! (there is a BUGS list in the Community Hub where you can notify me of any problems)

I will be adding user options for player height, as well as controls sensitivity soon.

notes.title: Menu System Added - WIP
notes.notes:
Added a new menu system. You can access this via the left Oculus Touch Menu/Home button. The menu itself is still very much work in progress but it does give you a lot of graphics options to enable you to increase frame rate vs quality. The anti-aliasing settings certainly can make a big difference. Let me know how you get on with it. (I don't think the SAVE button is working yet).

The game does not pause when you are in the menu system to avoid players using it as a cheat method for walking out of a fight in room scale while paused. So you need to find a quiet place to use it.

Next up I will be adding user settings to enable you to fine tune the feel of the controls.....

notes.title: Room Scale Snap Turning FIXED
notes.notes:
If you know what room scale snap turning is you'll know how big a deal this fix is. If not, then basically prior to this fix whenever you move in the real world you would get a pivot offset on your player rotations. Not that noticeable if you stay absolutely still while playing, but a major problem if you move around. Thanks to the clever boffins at MIT for solving this very complex problem!

At the moment I've given the new turning similar characteristics to that which you've already experienced. Except that if you jolt the thumbstick past 3/4 of it's travel you'll get a double speed turn rate, which is useful in fast skirmishes but also retains the slower fine control over direction. All these variables will be exposed to you in the up-coming user options menu.....

notes.title: Mother Mary Key Spawning Tweaks
notes.notes: If you want to progress throughout the graveyard you're going to need keys. Mother Mary now spawns keys more regularly (for the moment). She will spawn keys at a random point every 30secs to 2mins. Keys will vanish after 30 seconds. Beware, Mary is a zombie attraction.

notes.title: Performance Updates - Nvidia DLSS and NIS added. Spectator Mode disabled
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added support for [b]Nvidia DLSS[/b] on RTX graphics cards. DLSS is set to Ultra Performance by default. User menu settings will follow in a further update.
[*] Added support for [b]Nvidia NIS[/b] for non-RTX graphics cards. Again, set to Ultra Performance as default. User settings menu to follow.
[*] [b]Disabled HMD mirroring (Spectator Mode)[/b]. To re-enable this for video recording etc you can now toggle this on and off by pressing "S" on the keyboard.
[/list]

notes.title: Disabled all support for DirectX12
notes.notes:
Performance fix intended for RTX graphics cards to prevent DirectX12 features being enabled, Tested and confirmed working on RTX3070, AMD Ryzen 9 5900X, 64GB RAM.

Will be investigating adding support for Nvidia DLSS to further improve RTX framerates

notes.title: Lighting performance tweaks
notes.notes: Disabled a couple of lighting features (ambient occlusion and a few other things) to aid performance temporarily before graphics quality options go in
